title: NorthernSpeech - Videos
description: To meet the diverse needs of Speech-Language Pathologists who want to stay current with evidence-based practices, Northern Speech Services (NSS) offers clinically relevant Online CEUs, Live CEU Events, as well as comprehensive, innovative and highly effective Treatment Materials. Watch and learn how these programs and services can impact your practice!
